items.name: Finsupp.linearCombination_option
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (v : Option α → M) (f : Option α →₀ R),
  (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) f = f none • v none + (Finsupp.linearCombination R (v ∘ some)) f.some

items.name: Finsupp.apply_linearCombination
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {M' : Type u_8} [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (v : α → M) (l : α →₀ R),
  f ((Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l) = (Finsupp.linearCombination R (⇑f ∘ v)) l

items.name: Finsupp.lmapDomain_linearCombination
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {α' : Type u_7} {M' : Type u_8} [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M'] {v : α → M} {v' : α' → M'}
  (f : α → α') (g : M →ₗ[R] M'),
  (∀ (i : α), g (v i) = v' (f i)) →
    Finsupp.linearCombination R v' ∘ₗ Finsupp.lmapDomain R R f = g ∘ₗ Finsupp.linearCombination R v

items.name: Finsupp.linearCombination_apply
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {v : α → M} (l : α →₀ R), (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l = l.sum fun i a => a • v i

items.name: Fintype.linearCombination_apply
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_3) [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Semiring R] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_3 : Module R M] (v : α → M) (f : α → R), (Fintype.linearCombination R v) f = ∑ i, f i • v i

items.name: Finsupp.linearCombination_eq_fintype_linearCombination
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_3) [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Semiring R] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_3 : Module R M] (v : α → M),
  Finsupp.linearCombination R v ∘ₗ ↑(Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite R R α).symm = Fintype.linearCombination R v
